title: The sword pull
notes: The pull at Sword in the Stone (moved from World & story, Nov 21, 2026). Rules for it (Excalibur, 2 heads, the blessing, curse and runes coins, the pull's +/− name, who can pull): World & story → Sword in the Stone. The story around it: story → Legendary quests → Sword in the Stone.

n1.text: The stone stands alone beneath an open sky, the blade sunk in it to the hilt. Runes circle its base, worn almost smooth.

check.failCost: The sword is lost for good.

options.intent: Read the runes on the stone

check.failCost: Nothing is lost. A pass adds 1 coin to the pull.

n3.text: Steel sings against stone, and the blade comes free. Excalibur is yours.

n4.text: You pull until your arms shake, and the stone does not give. The sword is lost to you.

n5.text: The runes name the old kings, one after another, each hand the stone let go.

n6.text: The runes are too worn to read. Whatever they once said, they keep to themselves.

n8.notes: The sword is lost for good.
